title: Obscured set
html:
The Obscured set is a set of equipment that primarily benefits from the wearer or their target being lightly or heavily obscured. Also includes items that grant magical darkvision and blind immunity as they enhance what can be done in obscured areas. It overlaps somewhat with the Dark Justiciar Set, but items from that list are not duplicated here.

Name Slot Effect

Cloak of Cunning Brume 		 Cloak
Cunning Brume
When the wearer  Disengages, they also create a foggy cloud with 2 m / 7 ft radius that lasts for 1 turn.
